scenarios.name: Arab turnout reaches the survey level
scenarios.mechanism: Arab participation reaches the saved 63% Arab-including-Druze benchmark while Druze participation and every sector's list preferences remain fixed.

size.description: Interpret the memo's Arab-including-Druze benchmark on an in-person basis, convert to the disjoint effective Arab row, and change only that row's turnout.

envelope_offset.derivation: 100 * 2022 double-envelope ballots cast / 2022 national registered voters.

target.quote: | [Statnet projection reported by Reuters/ToI, 21 October 2026](https://www.timesofisrael.com/turnout-among-israels-arab-voters-could-make-or-break-hopes-to-unseat-netanyahu/) | Sample, fieldwork dates and turnout adjustment not disclosed in the report | **63% expected Arab turnout** | Most relevant recent sector forecast; methodology and historical denominator remain unresolved. |

definitions.quote: **Definitions matter for model ingestion.** The Arab series covers Arab/Druze localities and excludes Arab residents of mixed cities, other localities, and separately counted double-envelope ballots. The Druze column is a subset, not an additional population. The Haredi proxy covers **Elad, Beitar Illit and Modi’in Illit**; it is not representative evidence for every Haredi voter. [IDI, 20 December 2022](https://www.idi.org.il/articles/46754); [IDI, 15 November 2022](https://www.idi.org.il/articles/46440)

signature.observe: Aggregate ballots cast and registered voters in the frozen Arab and Druze box proxies, excluding separately counted envelopes; also report the official Arab/Druze locality series separately because the populations differ.

scenarios.name: Haredi mobilisation weakens
scenarios.mechanism: Haredi effective turnout falls to the turnout memo's 72% low end while all sector list preferences remain fixed.

size.description: Use the expressly permitted turnout-memo alternative: 79.7% to 72.0%, a 7.7-point fall, without turning historical seat misses into invented abstentions.

haredi_effective_target.derivation: Apply the memo's subjective community turnout low end directly to the effective Haredi proxy.

low_end.quote: | **Haredi** | **79%** | **72–85%** | Below the three-city historical benchmark, allowing dissatisfaction and weaker enforcement of communal participation. Strong final rabbinic instructions and organised mobilisation limit the expected decline. Nationwide measurement is the weakest of the three estimates. |

definition.quote: The final estimates below are **subjective marginal 10th–90th percentile ranges**, not survey confidence intervals or a fitted, back-tested turnout model. Overall means ballots cast divided by registered electors. Community estimates target eligible members of those communities, with extra uncertainty because their historical observations are geographic proxies. Arab includes Druze; Haredi includes Haredi settlers. These overlapping categories must not be added independently.
